# Copilot instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root: it describes what this site is, its structure, conventions and how to check changes.

Key rules: static site with no build step (HTML + CSS + native ES modules); one responsibility per file; modules communicate only through `js/core/events.js`; keep the no-WebGL and reduced-motion paths working; facts must match the owner's CV.
